name: Anycubic Kobra 2 Neo 0.4 nozzle
pre_gcode: M190 S{bed_temp} ; wait for bed temp
M109 S{temp} ; wait for extruder temp
G28; move X/Y/Z to min endstops
G1 Z0.28; lift nozzle a bit
G1 Y3 F1800                                    ; zero the extruded length
G1 X60  E25 F500                       ; Extrude 25mm of filament in a 5cm line.
G92 E0                                     ; zero the extruded length again
G1 E-2 F500                                ; Retract a little
G1 X70 F4000                              ; Quickly wipe away from the filament line
post_gcode: G1 Z+0.3 F3000                             ; lift print head
fan_gcode: M106 S{fan_speed}  ; p3d: add for orca slicer
